title: Agent environment v1
description: config/agent-env/<id>.json (AGENT-ENV, D-341): what one agent execution environment receives at session start: its provider, its non-secret variables, its secrets by name and reference only (never a value), its network hosts and its one starting credential. Validated by scripts/lib/agent_env.py, which also refuses a denied name (agent-env.denied_names, the retired vendors) and a secret reference outside the environment's prefix.

id.description: Equals the file name; names the environment's secret prefixes.

provider.description: The provider whose sessions run in the environment; a new provider is a new value here and one declaration.

variables.description: Name to non-secret value, set in the session as given.

secrets.description: Secrets by name only: the variable a session receives and where AWS keeps its value.

store.description: ssm: an SSM SecureString parameter, the default (free); secretsmanager: only where the secret already lives there.

ref.description: The parameter name (ssm, under /tower/agent-env/<id>/) or secret name (secretsmanager, under tower/agent-env/<id>/).

hosts.description: Exact lowercase host names; no scheme, port, path or wildcard.

starting_credential.description: The one credential the environment holds before delivery, given by hand once; AWS checks its sha256.

kind.description: bearer-env: a bearer token the session already has in the named environment variable.
